name: authenticate_saved_pdf_extraction
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,hashlib
p=Path.cwd()
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'inputs/sources/1411.6138.pdf'),'-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
saved=(p/'inputs/sources/1411.6138.txt').read_text()
assert r.stdout==saved,'Independent extraction differs; would require source reconciliation'
report={'pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'inputs/sources/1411.6138.pdf').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'independent_pdftotext_layout_matches_copied_text_exactly':True,'relevant_pages_read':[2,3,4,13,14,15,16,17,21,22,23,24,25],'no_figures_needed':True}
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'v1-extraction-authentication.json'],input=json.dumps(report,indent=2),capture_output=True,text=True);assert w.returncode==0
v=json.loads((p/'read-inventory.json').read_text());v['v1']['independent_pdf_extraction']='v1-extraction-authentication.json; freshly extracted actual saved PDF with pdftotext -layout, exact equality to text read'
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'read-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(v,indent=2),capture_output=True,text=True);assert w.returncode==0
print(json.dumps(report))
